Rare.name: Arcane Barrier
Rare.desc: Each time a face-up Spellcaster monster(s) on the field is destroyed, place 1 Spell Counter on this card (max. 4). You can send this card and 1 face-up Spellcaster monster you control to the GY; draw 1 card for each Spell Counter that was on this card.

Rare.name: Arcanite Magician
Rare.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Spellcaster monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: Place 2 Spell Counters on it. This card gains 1000 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from your field, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

Rare.name: Armed Samurai - Ben Kei
Rare.desc: For each Equip Card equipped to this card, it gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase.

Rare.name: Command Knight
Rare.desc: All Warrior monsters you control gain 400 ATK. If you control another monster, monsters your opponent controls cannot target this card for attacks.

Rare.name: Defender, the Magical Knight
Rare.desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Once per turn, if a Spellcaster monster(s) on the field would be destroyed, you can remove 1 Spell Counter from your field for each of those monsters instead.

Rare.name: Doom Dozer
Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 Insect-Type monsters from your Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

Rare.name: Fish Depth Charge
Rare.desc: Tribute 1 Fish-Type monster to target 1 card on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, draw 1 card.

Rare.name: Fuhma Shuriken
Rare.desc: Equip only to a "Ninja" monster. It gains 700 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

Rare.name: Glorious Illusion
Rare.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 "Lightsworn" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position. During each of your End Phases: Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

Rare.name: Kabazauls
Rare.desc: A huge monster in the shape of a hippopotamus. The sneezing from his gigantic body is so fierce that people mistake it for a hurricane.

Rare.name: Light-Imprisoning Mirror
Rare.desc: Negate all LIGHT monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

Rare.name: Mask Change
Rare.desc: Target 1 "HERO" monster you control; send it to the GY, also, after that, if it left the field by this effect, Special Summon 1 "Masked HERO" monster from your Extra Deck with the same Attribute that the sent monster had when it was on the field (its original Attribute, if face-down).

Rare.name: Nobleman of Crossout
Rare.desc: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Flip monster, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name.

Rare.name: Number 39: Utopia
Rare.desc:
2 Level 4 monsters
When a monster declares an attack: You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the attack. If this card is targeted for an attack, while it has no material: Destroy this card.

Rare.name: Precious Cards from Beyond
Rare.desc: When you Tribute Summon a monster using 2 or more Tributes: Draw 2 cards.

Rare.name: Raiza the Storm Monarch
Rare.desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 card on the field; place that target on the top of the Deck.

Rare.name: Secret Village of the Spellcasters
Rare.desc: If only you control a Spellcaster monster, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards. If you control no Spellcaster monsters, you cannot activate Spell Cards.

Rare.name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
Rare.desc: Negate all DARK monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

Rare.name: Shiny Black "C"
Rare.desc: During either player's turn, when exactly 1 Synchro Monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field: You can banish this card from your Graveyard to target that face-up Synchro Monster; destroy that target.

Rare.name: Tuningware
Rare.desc: This card can be treated as a Level 2 monster when used for a Synchro Summon. If this card is sent to the Graveyard for a Synchro Summon: Draw 1 card.
